assets.description: Steel-plant bridge crane recording; unreviewed candidate for a terminal crane substitute.
assets.creator: Work With Sounds / Technical Museum of Slovenia; sound recordist Dušan Oblak
assets.attribution: WWS Crane, Work With Sounds / Technical Museum of Slovenia, sound recordist Dušan Oblak, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); converted from Ogg Vorbis to PCM WAV; source https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:WWS_Crane.ogg
assets.authenticity_evidence: The item page identifies a five-ton bridge crane at a steel plant, not a container crane; suitability for any terminal action is unverified.
assets.playback_guidance: Candidate for playback once at a crane point source after listening review; do not loop without boundary review.
assets.processing: Original WWS_Crane.ogg downloaded from https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:Redirect/file/WWS_Crane.ogg; original SHA-256 0b673f3560432af138236c00c1f1bf7616f77e01af9f7c094d58466bd59e2d67. FFmpeg 7.1 essentials build: ffmpeg -hide_banner -i WWS_Crane.ogg -map 0:a:0 -ac 1 -ar 48000 -c:a pcm_s16le -n crane.wav. Source already mono 48000 Hz; decoded Vorbis to 16-bit PCM, no trimming or normalization. This is one derivative of one source; source_sha256 records the original Ogg download.
assets.quality_notes: Lossy 62 kbps Ogg Vorbis source limits fidelity. Automated PCM checks passed; perceptual quality and suitability remain unknown.
assets.review_notes: No listening was available; original and converted recording need listening and suitability review. Not release-ready. Loop boundaries have not been reviewed.

assets.description: Container ship gantry crane loading operation at Rauma; unreviewed full-recording candidate, with no verified contact event.
assets.creator: Work With Sounds / Werstas; sound recordist Teemu Ahola
assets.attribution: WWS Containershipgantrycrane, Work With Sounds / Werstas, sound recordist Teemu Ahola, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); converted and downmixed from Ogg Vorbis to mono PCM WAV; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:WWS_Containershipgantrycrane.ogg
assets.authenticity_evidence: Item page describes a container ship gantry crane loading M/S Sandy Rickmers at Rauma. It does not identify a specific contact or landing in the recording.
assets.playback_guidance: Pending listening and suitability review. No specific contact time or isolated landing has been established; do not use as a contact one-shot on that assumption.
assets.processing: Original WWS_Containershipgantrycrane.ogg downloaded from https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:Redirect/file/WWS_Containershipgantrycrane.ogg; SHA-256 4fe65a241f63091b6e7b7757b3feaf2e6df1b8eece18e9b57031d97e15aa5ff3. FFmpeg 7.1 essentials build: ffmpeg -hide_banner -i wws-contact.ogg -map 0:a:0 -ac 1 -ar 48000 -c:a pcm_s16le -n wws-contact.wav. Decoded stereo 96 kHz Vorbis, downmixed to mono and resampled to 48 kHz 16-bit PCM; no trimming or normalization. One derivative of one source.
assets.quality_notes: Lossy approximately 113 kbps Ogg Vorbis source limits fidelity. Automated checks found signal and no full-scale clipped samples; perceptual quality, downmix and suitability are unreviewed.
assets.review_notes: No listening available. Listen to original and converted recording, establish whether any usable contact is actually present and review any resulting edit. Not release-ready; loop boundaries unreviewed.

assets.description: Ursus C 342 agricultural tractor driving; unreviewed candidate substitute for terminal tractor movement.
assets.creator: Work With Sounds / Museum of Municipal Engineering; sound recordist Monika Widzicka
assets.attribution: WWS TractorUrsusC342driving, Work With Sounds / Museum of Municipal Engineering, sound recordist Monika Widzicka, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); downmixed, resampled and converted to PCM; source https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:WWS_TractorUrsusC342driving.ogg
assets.authenticity_evidence: The source identifies an early-1960s Ursus C 342 light agricultural tractor prototype driving, not terminal equipment. Suitability as a terminal vehicle substitute is unverified.
assets.playback_guidance: Candidate for playback once at a vehicle point source after listening review. Do not loop without boundary review.
assets.processing: Original downloaded from https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:Redirect/file/WWS_TractorUrsusC342driving.ogg; original SHA-256 18d879e54147e2a6e284d0c0c5a03dda0bc71ec99cf1b0498bb8f29d465a0acd. FFmpeg 7.1: ffmpeg -hide_banner -i tractor-driving.ogg -map 0:a:0 -ac 1 -ar 48000 -c:a pcm_s16le -n tractor-driving-ogg.wav. Decoded 44.1 kHz stereo Vorbis, downmixed to mono and resampled to 48 kHz 16-bit PCM; no trim or normalization. One derivative of one source.
assets.quality_notes: Lossy 107 kbps Ogg Vorbis source limits fidelity; mono downmix loses stereo information. Automated checks passed; perceptual quality and suitability remain unknown.
assets.review_notes: Listening unavailable: original and master require listening and suitability review; not release-ready. Loop boundaries have not been reviewed.
